proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.text: In season 6, Enoch wakes Fitz from the pod early, just before a strange energy spiral cuts his ship in half.

changes.evidence: Missing Pieces (AoS 6x01): Enoch wakes Fitz from the Cryo-Freeze Chamber as a spiral of energy grows and cuts the Chronicom vessel in two; Fitz and Enoch escape and have to look for another chamber. The file has no record of the pod's sleeper being woken or the ship being destroyed.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 6, Daisy and Simmons find Enoch's ship abandoned in space and the cryo pod empty.

proposed.text: In season 6, Daisy and Simmons track half of Enoch's wrecked ship to the D'Rillian scavenger Trok and find the cryo pod empty.

changes.evidence: Missing Pieces (AoS 6x01): a year after the attack, Daisy and Simmons land on D'Rill and interrogate Trok, who admits he bought half of the Chronicom vessel. They do not find the ship abandoned in space.
